Liangjia's ski simulator, developed over two years based on German professional skiing technology, represents China's first domestically developed classic skiing simulator.By incorporating AI-powered electrical algorithms, sensor-based motor drive systems, and hyper-realistic 3D HD visual software, we have created a cutting-edge sports entertainment product that effectively trains body balance, coordination, and reaction speed.



>> Features of Immersive Skiing:


  • AI-Powered Electrical Algorithms: Offers real-time adaptive difficulty and performance feedback.

  • Sensor-Based Motor Drive System: Delivers smooth, precise, and responsive movement control.

  • 3D HD Visual Simulation: Fully immersive alpine skiing environments rendered in high-definition graphics.

  • Balance & Motion Training: Actively engages core muscles to improve body control and coordination.

  • Multimode Settings: Includes training, competitive, and entertainment modes for diverse user needs.

  • User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive controls suitable for both beginners and experienced users.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Immersive Skiing:




Sports Training: A powerful tool for off-season training and technique refinement for skiers.


Fitness & Rehab: Helps users improve reflexes, muscle control, and physical endurance.


Entertainment Value: Offers an exhilarating skiing experience for gaming centers and arcades.



Education & Skill Development: Great for schools, fitness centers, and rehabilitation clinics to train balance and motor skills.


Made in China, World-Class Quality: A landmark domestic achievement built on global-grade German technology.












Certificate: CE certificate, complete product design patent certificate, and complete export certificate.


>> Product Number: LJST009


  • Floor area: 5m*5m*3m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-5 minutes

  • Power: 6500w

>> FAQs for Immersive Skiing:


Q1: Who can use the Immersive Skiing simulator?

A1: It is designed for all ages and skill levels, from beginners to professional skiers.


Q2: Does it simulate real skiing movements?

A2: Yes, the system uses motorized platforms and AI to simulate realistic slope angles, resistance, and turns.


Q3: What are the training benefits?

A3: It improves balance, coordination, reflexes, and lower body strength—similar to real skiing.


Q4: Is it suitable for gyms or rehab centers?

A4: Absolutely. Its precision and adjustability make it suitable for fitness, physical therapy, and rehabilitation.


Q5: How much space is required for installation?

A5: It requires a dedicated area depending on the simulator model, typically ranging from 4–8 square meters.
